svg.title: Nagoya Station — Tokaido Shinkansen
svg.desc: Floor-separated north-up schematic with ticket gates, platforms, elevators, accessible toilets and coin lockers. Geometry is simplified.

g.text: North Gate for elevators / Platforms 14–17 on 2F / Toilets & nearby coin lockers
Two gate areas. Use the North Gate for step-free platform access.
For elevators, enter via the North Gate.

g.title: NSK locker 5: Central Concourse, east of Shinkansen gates
NSK locker 6: Central Concourse south side, east of Shinkansen gates
Public lift to Fashion One B1 and the subway passage
NSK locker 10: Taikodori Exit / Umaimon Street

g.text: Continue east along the public concourse.
Match platform numbers with the 1F map.
North Gate or North Transfer Gate
The Central Concourse is outside ticket gates. All coin lockers shown on this map are outside the Shinkansen gates.
Wheelchair icons = accessible toilets. Locker numbers = official NSK banks. Schematic locations.
